name: 5gdeploy (NIST)
description: 5G core deployment helper by NIST's Smart Connected Systems Division. Deploys emulated 5G networks in Docker Compose with support for multiple control/user plane implementations.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Primarily useful for running an emulated 5G network in Docker Compose environment; compose, docker, and netdef-compose directories

eval_notes: Unique multi-vendor orchestrator: mix and match free5GC/OAI/Open5GS control planes with various UPF and RAN implementations. NIST-backed. In maintenance mode. Ideal for comparative testing. Unique multi-core, multi-UPF deployment tool. Enables comparative testing across different 5G core implementations. NIST-developed, high credibility. Good for cross-implementation eval scenarios. NIST-backed 5G deployment helper supporting multiple 5G core implementations. Useful meta-tool for orchestrating different signaling stacks in evaluation environments. No longer actively developed but functional.
